To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we present an approach to constructing proof of work that allows for controlled outsourcing of computation to workers, thereby reducing PoWork waste and preventing excessive aggregation of power in mining pools, and that our approach allows for the reuse of PoWork for other purposes such as spam prevention.
(1) we introduce PieceWork, a general approach to building PoW, (2) PieceWork allows for configurable outsourcing of work and (3) PieceWork can prevent mining pools from being economically viable.
PieceWork can reduce PoW waste by 90% and that it can reduce pool operation cost by 50%, which should reduce mining pool size and concentration of power.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a PoW system that allows for controlled outsourcing of PoW work, and that is not susceptible to inegalitarian mining pools.
the design and analysis of PieceWork, which is a generalized approach to constructing PoWs that can be configured to address the two key undesirable properties of PoW.
the design of a PoW that allows for controlled outsourcing and is resistant to mining pool aggregation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
PieceWork allows for PoW to be more useful, less wasteful, and less centralized.
PieceWork is a generalized approach to constructing PoWs that can be used to tackle the two key issues with PoW: waste and outsourcing.
PieceWork provides a general framework that can be used to design PoW systems that are more efficient, fairer, and secure than today's systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
PieceWork is a generalized outsourcing control for proof of work.
we introduce a new PoW variant that allows for controlled outsourcing, thereby enabling a wide range of additional applications and reducing the waste of PoW computation.
PieceWork enables the design of a PoW that is more secure and more egalitarian than existing ones.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the PoW security model can be generalized to allow for controlled outsourcing, which can lead to more egalitarian and efficient operation.
PoW can be made more efficient, more secure, and more egalitarian by carefully controlling its outsourcing.
PieceWork is an approach to PoW that is more flexible and secure than today’s PoW.
